resources.string: Share Continue watching and For you with your other KloudStream devices
Your history is kept in a private repository of your GitHub account, which only the KloudStream Sync app can access. Every device connected to it shares Continue watching and For you.
On your phone or computer, open %1$s and enter this code:
The access was revoked or expired: connect this device again.
KloudStream Sync is installed on none of your repositories: install it on kloudstream-sync, then connect again.
The code expired or was refused. Try again.
GitHub cannot be reached right now; next try in 2 minutes.
